يمتزجون (form VIII)
# يَمْتَزِجُونَ (yamtazijūna) /jam.ta.zi.d͡ʒuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِمْتَزَجَ (imtazaja)
# يُمْتَزَجُونَ (yumtazajūna) /jum.ta.za.d͡ʒuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِمْتَزَجَ (imtazaja)
